title: Codewars 6kyu: Find The Parity Outlier
description: You are given an array of minimum length 3 containing integers. The array is either entirely comprised of odd integers or entirely comprised of even integers except for a single integer `N`. Find and return this 'outlier' `N`.
constraints:
3 <= len(integers) <= 10^5
• Time: O(N) | Space: O(1) auxiliary
explanation: Inspects first 3 items to determine dominant parity, then returns the single divergent item in O(N) time.
